title: Junior box was disappointing
text: I was disappointed with the junior box.  I may try again when he's old enough for the regular box.  Junior box didn't really seem to be well through through. The theme was 'on the farm' but there were no seeds, nothing about life cycles (should we tell kids where meat comes from--nothing here to guide that conversation).  There were 1) stickers to put on a picture of a barn; 2) a red gift box that they called a barn and suggested you save some stickers for it too; 3) noses to glue to Popsicle sticks; 4) pieces of felt to practice lacing together and 5) felt carrots with holes and tops with numbers to match the number of holes to the Arabic numeral.  There was also a bonus wooden frame that a kid could paint (the nicest part of the box).  Finally, there was an insidious sticker chart, with a 'badge' to encourage the parent to not cancel the box.  The included guide just suggested questions like why are farms important?  It didn't seem to me there was any science in it, ad the quality felt disappointing.  I think it is hard to do a box like this for pre-schoolers; it looks like the grade school box is of higher quality, so maybe we'll try that.
label: negative
